name: North Tide's Hollow
summary: Moonrage worgen haunt North Tide's Hollow, a clearing just north of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Loyal to the rogue Archmage Arugal, they use it as a base to stalk the coastal woods.

sections.title: A Feral Foothold
sections.body: North Tide's Hollow lies in dense timber north of the Forsaken settlement of the Sepulcher. The savage Moonrage pack holds the hollow, worgen brought into Lordaeron by Archmage Arugal's reckless sorcery. Crude shelters scattered through the hollow offer the hardy beasts little more than bare necessities, yet give them a forward staging ground close to Forsaken travel routes.

sections.title: Under Shadowfang's Shadow
sections.body: The Moonrage worgen answer to a sinister will from Shadowfang Keep, unlike ordinary wilderness predators. Near the western shoreline and Silverpine's main road, they menace Forsaken couriers and patrols moving through the region.

faq.answer: North Tide's Hollow lies in western Silverpine Forest, just north of the Forsaken outpost of the Sepulcher and near the coastal bluffs.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit North Tide's Hollow?
faq.answer: Moonrage worgen, supernatural wolf-beasts bound to Archmage Arugal's madness, inhabit the hollow.

faq.q: Why do the worgen live in crude camps here?
faq.answer: Though vicious and wild, the Moonrage pack is cunning enough to organize basic camps. The worgen are resilient and hardened, needing only primitive shelters and necessities to endure Lordaeron's wilderness.

faq.q: Who controls the worgen in this area?
faq.answer: The Moonrage worgen in North Tide's Hollow serve Archmage Arugal, who summoned worgen into Lordaeron and commands them from Shadowfang Keep.

angles.text: Near the Sepulcher, the Moonrage pack in North Tide's Hollow threatens Forsaken sovereignty and logistical lines in Silverpine.
